_meta.status: HARVESTED, NOT YET WIRED — 22 of 157 effects carry a wiki-stated bonus type.
_meta.note: The dimension `essence_crafting.json` is missing. That shard has every PLACEMENT and every ML CURVE; the solver additionally needs the BONUS TYPE, because it buckets each contribution as (stat, bonus_type) and caps each bucket at one contributor. Harvested 2026-08-29 by reading all 157 craftable effect pages on the DDO wiki. Only `stated` is solver-eligible.
_meta.supersedes: The 2026-08-27 ruling in essence_crafting.json said NO reachable source records the type. That was too strong, and WHY is the part worth keeping: the earlier sampling looked for a type word NEAR the Essence Crafting mention. Several effect pages instead group their sources under `=== <Type> bonus ===` SECTION HEADINGS, so the type sits in the heading ABOVE the crafting line where a proximity search cannot see it. A section-aware read finds it. The other half of that ruling holds: the main Essence Crafting page (44 KB) and the four crafting tables state zero types, and gear-planner still ships no Essence pool.

join_shapes.same-line: A type word and the Essence Crafting reference in one line. Strongest.
join_shapes.section-heading: The crafting line sits under a `=== <Type> bonus ===` heading.
join_shapes.page-subject: The page's whole subject IS the bonus type, and it lists Essence Crafting as a source with a magnitude. Used once, for Natural Armor.
join_shapes.named-variant: The page names the crafted variant and types that variant by name elsewhere on the page. Used once, for Seeker.

_meta.not_inferred: `Insightful X` is NOT assumed to be an Insight bonus. Where one is recorded `stated`, a page said so outright. `Insightful Seeker` is the counter-example that earns the rule: the Seeker page names it, then assigns Insight to the FORMER 'Exceptional Seeker' instead — so it is `unsourced` despite its name.
_meta.corroboration: Two independent checks agree with the six ability results. (1) The wiki redirects `Insightful Strength`, `Insightful Constitution`, `Insightful Dexterity`, `Insightful Intelligence`, `Insightful Wisdom` and `Insightful Charisma` to `Insight bonus`. (2) The `Insight bonus` page states an Insight enchantment is worth half its Enhancement equivalent rounding down, and the harvested ML curves match: abilities 15/7, Accuracy 23/11, Haggle 20/10. Neither is treated as a source for an UNSTATED effect.

sources.effect_pages: https://ddowiki.com/page/<effect name> — all 157 read via the MediaWiki API

_meta.unreadable: 59 roster names have no readable page of their own: 52 return `missing` (mostly `Insightful X`, which the wiki documents on the base effect's page rather than separately) and 11 resolve to a disambiguation page. They are ABSENT from `harvested` rather than recorded as silent, so coverage still counts them as work to do. Three of them — Insightful Accuracy, Insightful Haggle, Insightful Spell Resistance — are `stated` anyway, sourced from the BASE effect's page.
